claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion problem,the concrete algorithm in proof.md has success at least0.395 under the sole disclosed heuristic that its fully charged,domain-separated SHA-256 computations behave as random functions for uniform challenges. collision-proof.md gives a finite idealized probability proof,without an assumed mean-collision bound. Deterministic total cold classical work,including all preprocessing,SHA computations,failed trials,pairings,output and verification,is at most2^(667/5) dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000. Peak storage<2^30 bytes,preprocessing below2^(667/5) equivalents is included,and advice is zero. Every access is within ordinary local64-bit memory. This is an exploratory heuristic production-success claim,not an unconditional fixed-SHA theorem or a practical execution. compression-proof.md gives the injective norm-one walk encoding and fully charged scalar computation. kernel-audit.md tightens full scalar call overhead while retaining complete charges. brent-proof.md gives the deterministic checkpoint budget and relation recovery.
